meta.title: Yuanfen | Your bridge to China
meta.description: Tour guiding, shopping (jasa titip), medical connections and university admission help in China, with local guides and partners. Your bridge to China, guided by fate.

hero.pitch: Local guides and trusted partners in China for your trip, your shopping, your hospital visit or your studies. We speak your language and stay with you.

services.title: What do you need help with?
services.text: Pick one. We'll take it from there.

tour.title: Tour Guiding
tour.line: A local guide for city tours, business trips, halal-friendly travel and airport pickup.

jastip.title: Shopping (Jasa Titip)
jastip.line: We buy what you need from China's markets and shops, on your behalf.

medical.title: Medical
medical.line: We connect you with hospitals, interpreters and consultations. No medical advice.

admission.title: University & School Admission
admission.line: Help finding and applying to a school or university in China.
